data.title: The race notice beside the water
data.goal: The race notice beside the water

memoryNodes.cue: Leo checks the teams and scheduled start on the race notice.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 利奥在比赛通知上查看队伍与预定开始时间。

memoryNodes.cue: The board charts changing results while a swimmer enters the nearby water.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 成绩板记录结果变化，附近一位游泳者正跃入水中。

memoryNodes.cue: The old headline describes a stunt, not today's organised session.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 旧标题描述特技，而非今天的组织活动。

data.situation:
Leo and Maya arrived at the riverside just before the boat race. The club notice listed the crews and the start time. Expectations had soared after a strong training result, although advance ticket sales plunged when rain was forecast. By Saturday, the rain had passed. Maya watched the winning crew cross the line, then followed Leo into the clubhouse. A results board showed that the crew's finishing time had improved dramatically since last season. Beside it hung an old headline calling a stunt performer a daredevil. 'Training brought them today's glory,' Leo said, pointing to the crew outside. Later, at a supervised swimming session nearby, an experienced swimmer plunged into the water at the instructor's signal. Maya stayed on the bank and watched. Club programme
Boat race: Meet the crews at the riverside viewing area before the scheduled start. Results will be posted in the clubhouse.
Swimming session: Wait on the bank for the instructor's signal before entering the water. Maya: Their time has improved dramatically. What changed?
Leo: They practised together all season. Regular training can lead to better performance.
Maya: Is that swimmer with the winning crew?
Leo: No, he's here for the swimming session.
Maya: He plunged straight in!
Leo: Yes, when the instructor gave the signal. I'll watch from here.

readingBlocks.zh: 划船赛开始前，利奥和玛雅来到河边。俱乐部通知列出了参赛队伍和开始时间。良好的训练成绩让大家期待大涨，预报有雨时，预售票销量却骤降。到了星期六，雨已经过去。玛雅看着获胜队冲过终点，随后跟着利奥走进俱乐部。成绩板显示，这支队伍的完成时间比上个赛季显著改善。旁边挂着一则旧新闻标题，把一名特技表演者称为胆大冒险的人。‘训练给他们带来了今天的荣耀。’利奥指着外面的队伍说。晚些时候，附近举行了一场有指导人员组织的游泳活动。一名有经验的游泳者听到教练信号，跃入水中。玛雅留在岸边观看。

readingBlocks.en:
Club programme
Boat race: Meet the crews at the riverside viewing area before the scheduled start. Results will be posted in the clubhouse.
Swimming session: Wait on the bank for the instructor's signal before entering the water.
readingBlocks.zh:
俱乐部活动安排
划船赛：请在预定开始时间前，到河边观赛区见参赛队伍。成绩将在俱乐部公布。
游泳活动：入水前，请在岸边等待教练的信号。

readingBlocks.en:
Maya: Their time has improved dramatically. What changed?
Leo: They practised together all season. Regular training can lead to better performance.
Maya: Is that swimmer with the winning crew?
Leo: No, he's here for the swimming session.
Maya: He plunged straight in!
Leo: Yes, when the instructor gave the signal. I'll watch from here.
readingBlocks.zh:
玛雅：他们的用时显著改善了，发生了什么变化？
利奥：整个赛季，他们都在一起练习。经常训练可以带来更好的表现。
玛雅：那个游泳者是获胜队的队员吗？
利奥：不是，他来参加游泳活动。
玛雅：他一下就跃进水里了！
利奥：对，教练发出信号时。我就在这里看。

glossary.note: 可数名词短语；a boat race，本文为划船队比赛。
glossary.example: Leo took Maya to watch a boat race.
glossary.exampleZh: 利奥带玛雅观看划船赛。

externalEvidence.definition: a race between people rowing or driving boats

glossary.note: 不及物动词；expectations / prices soar，本条不是鸟高飞义。
glossary.example: Expectations had soared after a strong training result.
glossary.exampleZh: 良好训练成绩之后，期待大幅上升。

glossary.note: 不及物动词；sales / prices plunge 表示骤降；plunge into water 则描述突然入水。
glossary.example: Advance ticket sales plunged when heavy rain was forecast.
glossary.exampleZh: 大雨预报使预售票销量骤降。

glossary.note: 副词修饰变化或改进；本句非戏剧表演风格义。
glossary.example: The crew's finishing time improved dramatically.
glossary.exampleZh: 船队的完成时间显著改善。

glossary.note: 通常不可数名词 bring glory to / win glory；与成绩数字本身分开。
glossary.example: The race brought glory to the winning team.
glossary.exampleZh: 比赛给获胜队带来荣耀。

glossary.note: lead to + 名词；can 表示可能，不保证每次训练都获胜。
glossary.example: Regular practice can lead to better performance.
glossary.exampleZh: 经常练习可能带来更好的表现。

glossary.zh: 爱冒险的人；鲁莽大胆的人
glossary.note: 可数名词，强调不顾风险的大胆；不等于所有勇敢或有技能的人。
glossary.example: The old headline called the stunt performer a daredevil.
glossary.exampleZh: 旧标题称特技表演者为胆大冒险的人。

glossary.note: plunge into 表示突然跃入；这里描述游泳者进入水中的动作。
glossary.example: The swimmer plunged into the water.

retrievalPrompts.function: The race notice beside the water
retrievalPrompts.cue: Describe the event and the expectations raised by training.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 描述活动和训练带来的期待。
acceptableAnswers: We went to a boat race. Expectations had soared after training, but advance ticket sales plunged when rain was forecast.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: expectations soar 与 ticket sales plunge 都是不及物动词用法，主语说明上升或下降的是哪个指标。boat race 是活动名词；训练后的期待上升与大雨预报后的预售票下降是不同变化，不能合成比赛成绩的变化。
checks: 交代活动是观看划船赛。
说明良好训练结果后期待大幅上升。
若描述预售票，明确大雨预报后的变化是销量骤降，不能把它误写成期待下降。
retrievalPrompts.answerRangeZh: 可只围绕划船赛及训练后的期待完成题目，也可补充雨预报后的票量骤降。须保留比赛与期待大涨；预售票是参考答案的扩展，不必强制补写。

retrievalPrompts.function: The race notice beside the water
retrievalPrompts.cue: Distinguish the swimmer's movement from the changes in results.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 区分游泳动作和成绩变化。
acceptableAnswers: The swimmer plunged into the water. Separately, the crew's finishing time had improved dramatically.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: plunge into the water 中 into 标出进入的方向；improve dramatically 中 dramatically 修饰改善幅度。这里改善的是完成用时，不能未经依据写成用时增加。
checks: 说明游泳者突然跃入水中。
说明另一例中的船队完成时间显著改善。
把入水动作与船队训练成绩分开，不将二者当作同一表现指标的变化。
retrievalPrompts.answerRangeZh: 可分句描述两件事，完成时间改善也可改述为明显缩短。须保留入水动作与船队用时改善的区别；不要求编造秒数或同一赛事结果。

retrievalPrompts.function: The race notice beside the water
retrievalPrompts.cue: Explain to a new team member how training relates to success.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 向新队员说明训练与获胜的关系。
acceptableAnswers: Practice can lead to better performance, but it does not guarantee glory in every race. Being a daredevil is not a substitute for training.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: lead to 后接名词短语 better performance；can 保留可能性。glory 表示荣耀，通常不可数；daredevil 指不顾风险的大胆者，不是对所有有技能队员的通称。
checks: 说明经常训练可能带来更好的表现。
明确训练不保证每场比赛获胜或得到荣耀。
若提到 daredevil，表达鲁莽冒险与有效训练的不同作用。
retrievalPrompts.answerRangeZh: 可用训练有助于改善表现的改述，不必同时塞入三个目标词。须保留训练的积极作用及不保证获胜的关系；鲁莽冒险不是替代训练的论点可作补充。

transferPrompt.function: The race notice beside the water
transferPrompt.cue: Your practice score has improved considerably. Summarise the change without guaranteeing the examination result.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 考试练习成绩显著改善，写一句不保证正式考试结果的总结。
acceptableAnswers: My practice score improved dramatically. Regular practice can lead to better performance, but the actual exam result is still uncertain.
transferPrompt.feedbackZh: improved dramatically 用副词说明变化幅度；can lead to better performance 用 lead to + 名词表达可能影响。练习成绩是已观察的变化，考试成绩是未来结果，两者的时态与确定程度应区分。
checks: 说明练习分数已经明显提高。
保留正式考试结果尚不确定，不将练习进步写成成绩保证。
按中文题意用一句总结；若谈训练作用，保持可能性，不把它写成获胜保证。
transferPrompt.answerRangeZh: 可在一句中用转折、让步或其他自然结构连接练习进步与考试仍未确定。须保留练习分数明显改善及不保证正式考试结果，不要求解释进步原因、加入具体分数或使用全部参考表达。
